Style 4: the pick bar and the Turn dock

1. Colors and type2. Action card3. Chat cards4. Pick bar and Turn dockThe NPC sheetThe HUD

The two pieces that sit beside the HUD. The pick bar (a choice on the map; inside the HUD when one is open, floating when not) is dark already, but a cold blue-black with rounded blue-grey buttons: here it takes the HUD's look (the warm page, a gold line, outlined buttons, the hovered pick as a stamp). The Turn dock (above the chat's input) takes the dark page and a band for its head.
